title: W1_T1: Tutorial 1: Forward pass & backpropagation
instructor: IITM BS tutorial (Chandan / TA); course Prof. Prathosh A. P.
description: Week 1 Tutorial 1: Algorithm for f-divergence minimization via variational lower bounds and Fenchel conjugates (F-GAN foundation). Note: YouTube video is titled 'Forward pass & backpropagation' by the channel, but the lecture content covers f-divergence minimization, Fenchel duality, LOTUS, and Variational Divergence Estimation.
topics: The Generative Setup and f-Divergence Objective
The Intractability Bottleneck: Unknown Densities and High Dimensions
The Statistical Bridge: LOTUS and Monte Carlo Sample Averages
The Entanglement Obstacle: Trapped Density Ratios
Convex Functions and the Fenchel Conjugate
Biconjugacy: Reconstructing Functions via Supporting Hyperplanes
Swapping Supremum and Integral: Lifting Scalars to Function Space
The Variational Lower Bound and Expectation-Based Optimization
